## What it is

The plate that drops onto the four bar ends. It is 4.5 mm thick. The pockets go through, so they are 4.5 mm deep. The underside sits 117.3 mm above the deck and the top is at 121.8 mm. The centre hole is Ø65.2 mm.

## Design notes

- Each pocket is 16.8 × 8.2 mm, the same plain opening as the ring slot, including the bolt chamfer.
- The hoop stays inboard of the mouths, so the tube still presses in from outside with the cap on.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```

## Don't

- Don't enlarge the hoop out to the bar. That would close the mouths.
